title: Source-Bound WOFOST Lifecycle/Biomass State Reconciliation

findings: DVS and TSUM are initialized separately from the WOFOST_states biomass object.
WRT/WST/WSO and leaf-cohort state are initialized when the crop trajectory becomes active.
LAI is immediately calculated as LASUM + SSA*WST + SPA*WSO rather than advanced as an independent prognostic variable.
WRT/WST/WSO and leaf cohorts are updated from prior biomass state.
LAI is recalculated after biomass/cohort updates as LASUM + SSA*WST + SPA*WSO.
DVS and TSUM are updated as crop-development state outside WOFOST_states.
Actual plant-interface WRT is copied from the actual WOFOST state.
Actual LAI is copied from the actual WOFOST state's recalculated LAI.
Potential WRTPOT and potential state come from the separate potential trajectory.

F_WOF20.decision: retain for its admitted common route; do not embed unchanged inside actual-WOFOST composite

current_lineage_reconciliation.resolution: WOFOST-specific atomic owner stores crop_emerged and DVS directly plus optional primary biomass; WOFOST LAI is only a derived read-only view.

scientific_nonclaims: DVS alone is not the complete phenology continuation required for future WOFOST evolution.
F-WOF24 does not qualify TSUM/vernalization/anthesis continuation.
F-WOF24 does not qualify leaf-cohort ageing or creation cadence.
F-WOF24 does not qualify arbitrary subdaily WOFOST evolution.
The composite is qualified only as an atomic current physical-state/view boundary for already-qualified downstream consumers.
